name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn]

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
en: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: The people of Lot denied the warning

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
en: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
en: So taste My punishment and warning

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar

name: Al-Qamar · القمر
ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination
